en.title: What a seventh round of games still had to guess
en.body: Four games written from `llms.txt` alone all ran at their first try; what they still guessed is now there. `game.follow` takes `lookY`, to look above the thing it follows and frame a tower or a sky, and the page gives `game.camera.fov` and how to lay a cylinder or a cone on its side. Rain falls as streaks, not dots. A play script for `tools/verify-game.mjs` starts a new game, with what blind play saved forgotten, and `player.read(fn)` reads what a game keeps on `window`; the page says how `player.until` waits. It also gives the arguments of gradient lines and that `game.tiles` takes a `layer` and what its `pushOut` returns.

zh.title: 第七轮游戏还要猜的东西
zh.body: 四个只读 `llms.txt` 写成的游戏第一版都直接跑通，它们还在猜的地方现在都写清了。`game.follow` 支持 `lookY`，让镜头看向跟随物体上方，用来把高塔或天空收进画面；说明页写明了 `game.camera.fov` 以及怎样把圆柱、圆锥横放。雨现在下成雨丝，而不是圆点。`tools/verify-game.mjs` 的试玩脚本会以新游戏开始，盲玩存下的进度会被清掉；`player.read(fn)` 可以读取游戏放在 `window` 上的状态；说明页写明了 `player.until` 的等待方式。另外补上了渐变线条的参数，以及 `game.tiles` 可以传 `layer` 和它的 `pushOut` 返回什么。
